user.title: RoomCall intercom
user.description: Choose the speakers that should play intercom messages. Rooms come from each speaker's Home Assistant area. Pick one entity per physical speaker so messages are not played twice. Chimes, quiet hours and notifications are under Configure afterwards.

data_description.volume: Leave empty to keep each speaker's current volume. Supported by Sonos.
data_description.gain_db: Raise this if phone recordings sound quiet.
data_description.speech_rate: 1 is the voice's normal pace. Lower it if typed messages and announcements sound too fast; 0.85 is a little slower. Pitch stays the same.

data_description.volume: Leave empty to keep each speaker's current volume. Supported by Sonos.

chime_options.name: Chime
chime_options.description: The sound played before every call.

data_description.custom_url: An MP3/WAV URL or a path such as /config/www/chime.mp3. Overrides the chime above.

data.restore: Put speakers back after a call

data_description.stagger_ms: Some speakers (several Sonos in one home) drop announcements that arrive at the same moment. A short offset fixes it.
data_description.restore: For speakers that can't announce (AV receivers, TV boxes): restore input, volume, power and the app that was open.

quiet_hours.name: Quiet hours
quiet_hours.description: During quiet hours calls play quieter and skip the rooms you choose. Urgent calls ignore quiet hours and Do Not Disturb.

data.skip_areas: Rooms to skip during quiet hours

data_description.notify: Each call sends a notification. The caller's own phones are skipped.
data_description.dashboard_path: For example /home-hub/home. Adds a Reply button that opens the card aimed back at the caller's room.
data_description.stt_engine: Optional. Adds the spoken words to notifications and call history.

homekit.name: Apple Home
homekit.description: Show each room in the Apple Home app as a camera with a talk button. Hold the microphone in Home, on your Apple Watch or in Control Center to talk in that room.

data_description.port: Change only if another HomeKit bridge already uses it.

data.prefer_music_assistant: Prefer Music Assistant in these rooms

data_description.talk_back: After someone talks to a room from another room, an Assist satellite in that room (Atom Echo, ESP32-S3, Home Assistant Voice) listens for a reply and the caller's room hears it. Replies are transcribed, then spoken in your voice of choice.
data_description.doorbell_entity: The doorbell button or event. When it rings, RoomCall says who is at the door, notifies phones with an Answer button, and shows a banner on RoomCall cards.
data_description.doorbell_camera: Answer opens this camera's live view, where two-way talk works when the camera supports it.
data_description.playback_routes: Map a playback entity to an explicit controller and source for its audio output. HDMI connections are not inferred from room names. Restoration and app resumption depend on device support.
data_description.prefer_music_assistant: For verified copies of the same physical speaker, prefer its Music Assistant player. Unknown MA identities still need manual selection; this setting never matches devices by room or name.

options.agent_prompt: Call roomcall__catalog first for schemas and the setup bootstrap recipe. Discover capabilities first. Preview exact recipients before sending. Supply explicit targets. Reuse an idempotency key when retrying. Check status. Request acceptance is not proof of audibility or acknowledgment. Never upgrade a blocked message to urgent automatically. Administrator setup: discover, plan, list/get to resume, apply with the plan revision, test/confirm each speaker, verify, or undo with explicit confirmation. Plans expire after 24 hours; never infer human audibility. Administrator announcement management: discover schemas, list, create idempotently, update, enable/disable or delete. Existing announcements require their current revision; deletion requires confirm=true. Announcement tasks: complete one only when a person says they did it.

options.shortcut_remote_consent: Send the room name/ID and shortcut to RoutineHub for signing. No HA address, token or spoken message is included.
options.shortcut_signing_help: Cherri: compile the source with cherri --hubsign. Mac: use shortcuts sign --mode anyone. A signed download requires your own HubSign account. The integration never stores the key.
options.shortcut_signing_required: Signed downloads require a HubSign key and consent to external signing. Local source exports need neither.

options.shortcut_format_native: Native Perform Action template — unsigned, sign on a Mac
options.shortcut_native_ask: 1. In Apple Shortcuts, add Ask for Input (Text) with the prompt: {prompt}
options.shortcut_native_dictionary: Fixed destination: {name} ({room}). The generated native template already includes the message Dictionary.
options.shortcut_native_action: 3. Add Home Assistant → Perform Action. Select your server and roomcall.broadcast. Set Action data to the Dictionary variable. Name it RoomCall {name}.
options.shortcut_native_note: Select the server once on your iPhone. This avoids the URL confirmation; iOS may still request permissions or unlocking.

options.shortcut_message_ask: Ask for text or Siri dictation
options.shortcut_message_input: Use text passed by another shortcut
options.shortcut_live_help: The native template retrieves your current permitted RoomCall rooms each time it runs. Choose destinations by name; IDs and the message Dictionary are filled automatically. Everywhere is an explicit choice.
options.shortcut_input_help: Pass text into this shortcut using Run Shortcut or the share sheet. No message prompt is added; empty input is rejected by RoomCall.
options.shortcut_native_import: Sign and import the native template. During setup select your server and the indicated action for each Home Assistant step: roomcall.communicate for both live-picker steps, or roomcall.broadcast for a fixed room. No server ID or credentials are embedded.

broadcast.name: Broadcast

areas.name: Rooms
areas.description: Areas to broadcast to. Leave empty (and no people) for every RoomCall speaker.

people.name: People
people.description: Play in the room each person is in right now (needs room presence, for example Bermuda).

message.name: Message
message.description: Text spoken with the configured text-to-speech engine.

media_url.name: Media URL
media_url.description: Audio file URL or media-source ID to play instead of a message.

priority.name: Priority
priority.description: Urgent calls play louder and ignore Do Not Disturb and quiet hours.

speakers.name: Speakers
speakers.description: Specific media players to play on, in addition to rooms and people.

communicate.name: Communicate
communicate.description: Discover capabilities first. Preview exact recipients before sending. Supply explicit targets. Reuse an idempotency key when retrying. Check status. Request acceptance is not proof of audibility or acknowledgment. Never upgrade a blocked message to urgent automatically.

missing_speakers.title: RoomCall speakers are unavailable
missing_speakers.description: These RoomCall speakers are unavailable or no longer exist: {speakers}. Calls to their rooms will not play. Turn them on, or remove them under Settings → Devices & services → RoomCall → Configure.

https_internal_url.title: RoomCall speakers may not reach Home Assistant

confirm.title: Review the local network URL
confirm.description:
Speakers download calls from {url}. {reason} Open this repair to review a LAN address.

Change Home Assistant’s internal URL from {current_url} to {suggested_url}? This shared setting affects other integrations too. Confirm only if speakers can reach this address. A listening test is still required.

abort.no_lan_url: No usable LAN address could be suggested. Open Settings → System → Network and set an address reachable from speakers. If HA serves HTTPS directly, configure a trusted certificate or an HTTP proxy first.
abort.cancelled: Cancelled. The internal URL was not changed.
abort.url_changed: The internal URL changed while this repair was open. Reopen the repair to review a fresh proposal.
